New To Market
By Private Treaty
53 Pococke Valley Johnswell Road Kilkenny
Guide Price €325,000/Presently Under Offer
Viewing with Auctioneer By Appointment.
Sale of two storey semi-detached residence 961.540 sq ft., constructed in 1996.
Ground floor entrance hall, fitted kitchen/dining area, living room with open fireplace.
First floor 3 bedrooms, main bathroom (bath and shower).
PVC double glazed windows.  Gas heating system Ber Rating D2.
Font and back garden area with garden shed, off street parking for two cars.
Eir Code R95 D5WT.  Situated to the front of the estate overlooking the public green area, Johnswell road, within walking distance to Lidl and Newpark Shopping Centre. Local Kilkenny Bus service, less than five minutes’ drive to the M9 Motorway.  One mile Kilkenny city centre.
